The figure didn't come through, so I assumed the bar is a straight strip of 10 triangles, each sharing an edge with the next. This is a guess, so the answer is only as good as that assumption.

Under that assumption, the triangles form a path of 10 pieces with 9 shared edges between neighbours. Each shared edge is either cut or not cut. Every choice of cuts gives a valid division into contiguous pieces, so there are 2⁹ = 512 divisions.

The "two or more pieces" condition excludes the one division with no cuts, which leaves the whole bar as one piece. That gives 512 − 1 = 511.

ANSWER: 511
